resources.string: This app contains the game. It is for your own devices only: do not share it.
This app was built for the %1$s edition of the game.
This ISO is a different edition of the game. This app was built for the %1$s edition and will not start with another one: choose the %1$s ISO, or build the app from this ISO.

Copy your ISO with the Files app to On My iPhone › NFS Most Wanted, or from a computer with Finder (the iPhone\'s Files tab). You can also choose it anywhere in Files with the button: it is read where it is, not copied.
iOS no longer gives access to the chosen ISO: it may have been moved or deleted. Choose it again.
The settings apply when you press Play. To change them later, close the app from the app switcher and open it again.
In the game, the gear next to the HIDE button opens the editor: move the touch buttons and change their size and opacity.
The phone vibrates like this when the game rumbles the touch controls. A physical controller vibrates by itself.
The shader library (nfsmw_shaders.nfsp), which the native renderer needs, is missing. Copy it to the app\'s folder, next to the ISO, or build the app with it.
The iOS low-latency output of this app, like AAudio on Android. Off: the SDL output of the native engine.
Faster shaders on the iPhone GPU, with less exact math: it can bring back colored squares or flashes. Off: the same math as on Android.
